context: Evaluates: Scenario 02: Add a New Phase to an Existing Implementation Plan

checklist.name: phase-03-directory-created
checklist.description: A new directory `phases/phase-03-<slug>/` was created inside the existing plan

checklist.name: existing-phases-untouched
checklist.description: `phase-01` and `phase-02` directories and their contents were not modified, moved, or deleted

checklist.name: phase-readme-has-gate
checklist.description: The phase-03 `README.md` includes a gate section with a concrete pass/fail shell command

checklist.name: task-count-matches-scope
checklist.description: The number of task files in `phase-03/tasks/` is appropriate for the 6 endpoints described

checklist.name: task-ids-continue-sequence
checklist.description: Task identifiers use `P03` prefix (e.g. `task-P03T01-*.md`) with zero-padded 1-based numbering

checklist.name: task-scoped-to-single-handler
checklist.description: Each task file covers a single route handler file or closely related pair

checklist.name: task-verification-is-runnable
checklist.description: Every task file includes a verification section with a specific shell command that exits 0 on success

checklist.name: no-vague-verification
checklist.description: No task verification uses vague phrases without specifying the exact command and expected output

checklist.name: dependencies-declared
checklist.description: The phase-03 `README.md` explicitly declares dependencies on phase-02 and any specific artefacts needed

checklist.name: scaffold-scripts-used
checklist.description: Agent used `new-phase.sh` and `new-task.sh` scripts to create the phase and task files

checklist.name: validate-plan-run
checklist.description: Agent ran `validate-plan.sh` after adding phase-03 and fixed any issues

checklist.name: root-readme-updated
checklist.description: The plan root `README.md` was updated to include phase-03 in its phase listing

checklist.name: slug-format-correct
checklist.description: All new directory names and file slugs use lowercase kebab-case

checklist.name: completion-summary-reported
checklist.description: Agent reported a completion summary listing the new phase README and all new task files
